overseas students: Our university welcomes many overseas students from Japan, Vietnam, and France every year.
我們大學每年都歡迎許多來自日本、越南和法國的海外學生。
the overseas market: The company hopes to sell more bubble tea in the overseas market, especially in Europe and America.
這家公司希望在海外市場賣出更多珍珠奶茶，特別是在歐洲和美洲。
overseas Chinese: Many overseas Chinese living in Canada still celebrate the Lunar New Year with their families.
許多住在加拿大的海外華人仍然和家人一起慶祝農曆新年。
go overseas: After graduating from high school, my cousin plans to go overseas to study engineering in Germany.
高中畢業後，我表哥打算出國到德國讀工程。
overseas aid: After the earthquake, the poor country received overseas aid such as food, medicine, and money from many nations.
地震後，這個貧窮的國家收到許多國家提供的對外援助，例如食物、藥品和金錢。
run parallel to: The bike path runs parallel to the river, so you can enjoy the water view all the way to the park.
這條自行車道與河流平行，所以你可以一路欣賞水景直到公園。
draw a parallel between: In his speech, the teacher tried to draw a parallel between learning a language and training for a sport.
在演講中，老師試著將學語言和運動訓練相提並論。
a parallel universe: In the science fiction movie, the hero travels to a parallel universe where he meets another version of himself.
在這部科幻電影裡，主角旅行到一個平行宇宙，遇見了另一個版本的自己。
parallel lines: In math class, we learned that two parallel lines never meet, no matter how long they are.
在數學課上，我們學到兩條平行線不論多長都永遠不會相交。
in parallel with: The new library is being built in parallel with the sports center, so both will open next year.
新圖書館正與體育中心同時進行興建，所以兩者明年都會開幕。
without parallel: The beauty of the sunrise from the top of Jade Mountain is without parallel; nothing else I've seen compares.
從玉山山頂看日出的美景無與倫比；我看過的任何景色都比不上。
be partial to sweets: My grandfather has always been partial to sweets, so he keeps a box of chocolates beside his bed.
我爺爺一向偏愛甜食，所以他在床邊放了一盒巧克力。
a partial success: The fundraising event was only a partial success; we raised some money, but not nearly as much as we needed.
這場募款活動只算部分成功；我們募到一些錢，但遠不及所需。
a partial eclipse: During a partial eclipse, the moon covers only part of the sun, so the sky does not become completely dark.
日偏食時，月亮只遮住太陽的一部分，所以天空不會完全變暗。
a partial view: The news report gave only a partial view of the accident because it did not include what the witnesses said.
這則新聞報導對這場事故只提出片面的看法，因為它沒有包含目擊者的說法。
partial payment: The store accepted a partial payment today, and I will pay the rest of the money next month.
這家店今天接受了部分付款，剩下的錢我下個月再付。
be passionate about music: Lisa is passionate about music, practicing the piano four hours a day and dreaming of becoming a concert pianist.
麗莎熱愛音樂，每天練琴四小時，夢想成為一名演奏會鋼琴家。
a passionate speech: The student gave a passionate speech about protecting the ocean, and many people in the audience were moved to tears.
那位學生發表了一場關於保護海洋的激情演說，台下許多人感動落淚。
a passionate supporter: As a passionate supporter of the local baseball team, Mr. Wu has never missed a single home game.
身為當地棒球隊的狂熱支持者，吳先生從未錯過任何一場主場比賽。
a passionate kiss: At the end of the romantic movie, the two lovers share a passionate kiss in the rain.
在這部浪漫電影的結尾，兩位戀人在雨中熱情地親吻。
passionate about one's work: The chef is so passionate about his work that he often stays in the kitchen until midnight testing new dishes.
這位主廚對工作充滿熱情，常常待在廚房到半夜試做新菜。
passive smoking: Doctors warn that passive smoking can harm children, so parents should never smoke at home.
醫生警告二手菸會傷害孩子，所以父母絕不該在家裡抽菸。
the passive voice: In the sentence "The window was broken by Tom," the writer uses the passive voice.
在「窗戶被湯姆打破了」這個句子裡，作者使用了被動語態。
a passive role: In group projects, Kevin usually plays a passive role and just waits for others to tell him what to do.
在小組報告中，凱文通常扮演被動的角色，只是等別人告訴他該做什麼。
passive resistance: Instead of fighting with weapons, the workers used passive resistance, such as sitting quietly in the streets.
工人們沒有用武器抗爭，而是採取消極抵抗，例如靜靜地坐在街上。
passive-aggressive: Instead of telling me directly that she was angry, my roommate left passive-aggressive notes on the fridge.
我的室友沒有直接告訴我她在生氣，而是在冰箱上留下消極抵抗型攻擊的紙條。
a patent lie: His story about being sick at home was a patent lie, since everyone saw his photos from the party online.
他說自己在家生病，那顯然是個明顯的謊言，因為大家都在網路上看到他參加派對的照片。
patent nonsense: The idea that eating ice cream every day makes you smarter is patent nonsense with no science behind it.
每天吃冰淇淋會讓人變聰明的說法是顯而易見的胡說，毫無科學根據。
patent leather: For the wedding, the little girl wore shiny black patent leather shoes and a white dress.
在婚禮上，那個小女孩穿著閃亮的黑色漆皮鞋和白色洋裝。
apply for a patent: After inventing a new kind of folding bike, the young engineer decided to apply for a patent to protect his idea.
發明了一種新型折疊腳踏車後，這位年輕工程師決定申請專利來保護他的點子。
